notes: This sheet is drawn with north to the LEFT: Chase Av., Vandalia, Ludlow Pl. and Knowlton run up and down the page, Dane (top), Chambers, Mad Anthony and Fergus (bottom) run across it. Bare printed names written with Street: DANE, CHAMBERS, MAD ANTHONY, KNOWLTON, FERGUS, VANDALIA; LUDLOW PL. -> Ludlow Place, LINGO ST. -> Lingo Street. Vandalia is the ~78-80 ft corridor along the C.H.&D. R.R.: house numbers face it from both sides (1300-1312 west, 1301 and 1317 east, 1438 south of Mad Anthony), the two tracks run in its west half and the VANDALIA label is printed in its east half, with no line between them. Vandalia points are taken midway between the block faces. If only the strip east of the tracks is roadway, they would sit about 20 ft (~120 px) further east, measured square to the street. Vandalia south of Mad Anthony is unlabelled (same corridor), and the points there (Knowlton crossing, Fergus) are approximate. No width is printed for Vandalia or for Lingo on this sheet. Chase bends slightly at Chambers and turns at Fergus. Dane, Chambers, Mad Anthony and Fergus continue off both sides (634 west, 626 east). Block numbers 1 and 3 are printed between the tracks, and 2 on the 10 ft alley. Circled numbers are grade elevations.
